hotels.name: The Leela Kovalam
hotels.description: Perched on a cliff overlooking the Arabian Sea, The Leela offers an unparalleled blend of luxury and natural beauty. Tiered gardens cascade down to the beach.

hotels.name: Niraamaya Retreats Surya Samudra
hotels.description: A collection of authentic Kerala heritage homes relocated and restored on a cliff edge overlooking the sea. An intimate retreat with world-class Ayurveda.

hotels.name: Beach & Lake Resort Alleppey
hotels.description: Situated between the beach and the backwaters, this resort offers the best of both Kerala's coastal worlds. Perfect for family holidays.

hotels.name: Fragrant Nature Backwater Resort
hotels.description: Set amidst paddy fields and coconut palms on the backwater shore, this eco-friendly resort offers an authentic Kerala village experience with modern comforts.

hotels.name: Spice Village by CGH Earth
hotels.description: A unique eco-resort designed as a tribal hamlet with thatched cottages set in a working spice plantation adjacent to Periyar Tiger Reserve.

hotels.name: Munnar Tea County Resort
hotels.description: Nestled in 2500 acres of tea estates at 5000 feet, this hill resort offers spectacular valley views and the unique experience of staying in a working tea plantation.

hotels.name: Windermere Estate
hotels.description: A heritage plantation estate with bungalows offering sweeping views of misty valleys. The property grows coffee, tea, and cardamom and has walking trails through the estate.

hotels.name: CGH Earth - Fort House
hotels.description: A boutique heritage hotel in a 19th-century building in Fort Kochi's historic district, steps from the Chinese fishing nets and colonial-era churches.

hotels.name: Brunton Boatyard
hotels.description: Built to evoke the Dutch and Portuguese trading era, this waterfront hotel occupies a historic boatyard with views of the busy harbor and Chinese fishing nets.

hotels.name: Vythiri Resort
hotels.description: A forest resort with iconic treehouses perched above the rainforest canopy. Zipline, rock climbing, and guided treks make it an adventure lover's paradise.

hotels.name: Zostel Kozhikode
hotels.description: A vibrant backpacker hostel in the heart of Kozhikode, perfect for solo travelers and budget-conscious tourists wanting to explore Malabar culture.

hotels.name: Harivihar Heritage Home
hotels.description: A 200-year-old Brahmin home converted to a boutique heritage hotel. Authentic Kerala meals, Ayurvedic treatments, and cultural immersion in a serene setting.

hotels.name: Bekal Resorts & Spa
hotels.description: A premium beach resort steps from the historic Bekal Fort with stunning sea views, an infinity pool, and world-class Ayurvedic spa.

hotels.name: Kannur Beach House
hotels.description: A charming budget beach house with direct sea access. Simple but well-maintained rooms, excellent local cuisine, and arranged Theyyam performances for guests.

hotels.name: Thrissur Pride Hotel
hotels.description: A comfortable city hotel in the heart of Kerala's cultural capital, ideal for visiting Thrissur Pooram, temples, and Athirappilly Falls.

hotels.name: Green Woods Bethlehem Munnar
hotels.description: A peaceful budget resort amidst lush green tea gardens with valley-facing rooms, home-cooked Kerala food and breathtaking misty mornings.

hotels.name: Spice Garden Thekkady
hotels.description: Set inside a spice plantation, guests can tour the garden, spot wildlife and enjoy organic meals prepared with freshly harvested spices from the farm.

hotels.name: Varkala Cliff Heritage Resort
hotels.description: Perched on the famous Varkala cliff with direct sea-view rooms, private sundecks and steps down to the mineral spring beach. Yoga sessions every morning.

hotels.name: Fort Heritage Boutique Hotel
hotels.description: A lovingly restored 150-year-old colonial bungalow in Fort Kochi's heritage zone with antique furniture, courtyard garden and walking distance to all major attractions.

hotels.name: Zostel Wayanad
hotels.description: India's best-known hostel chain's Wayanad property set in a converted plantation bungalow with dorms, private rooms and an amazing social backpacker community.

hotels.name: Paradise Resort Alleppey
hotels.description: A backwater luxury resort with private pool villas built over the water, sunset boat cruises included, personal butler and award-winning Kerala cuisine restaurant.

hotels.name: Blue Sea Hotel Kovalam
hotels.description: A friendly budget hotel steps from Lighthouse Beach with sea-facing rooms at incredibly affordable prices. Great base for backpackers exploring south Kerala.

hotels.name: Kannur Beach Palace
hotels.description: A comfortable sea-facing hotel near Payyambalam Beach with spacious rooms, rooftop sea views and easy access to Kannur's top attractions including Fort St. Angelo.

hotels.name: Rainforest Resort Athirappilly
hotels.description: Nestled inside the forest just 2 km from Athirappilly Falls with tented cottages, jungle walks and a natural swimming pool fed by a mountain stream. Fireflies at night!

hotels.name: Fort Palace Hotel Palakkad
hotels.description: A clean, well-located budget hotel with a view of the historic Palakkad Fort from upper floors. Central location makes it perfect for exploring both the fort and the city market.

hotels.name: Bekal Court Kasaragod
hotels.description: A premium resort overlooking the historic Bekal Fort and the Arabian Sea with Kerala-style thatched cottages, infinity pool, Ayurveda centre and private beach access.

hotels.name: Ashtamudi Lake Resort
hotels.description: A charming lakeside resort on the banks of Ashtamudi Lake with wooden cottages on stilts, morning canoe rides and spectacular lake sunsets. Kerala home food included.

hotels.name: Hillside Retreat Malappuram
hotels.description: A quiet hillside guesthouse near Nilambur surrounded by rubber and teak plantations. Perfect base for exploring Nilambur's teak museum and Kadalundi bird sanctuary.

hotels.name: Bekal Backpackers Inn
hotels.description: A clean and affordable guesthouse near Bekal Fort, ideal for budget travellers wanting to explore the historic fort and pristine beaches of northern Kerala.

hotels.name: Nideshwaram Heritage Hotel
hotels.description: A beautifully restored heritage property near Nileshwaram Palace with traditional Kerala architecture, lush gardens, and home-cooked Malabar cuisine. Close to pristine beaches.

hotels.name: Ananda Beach Resort Kasaragod
hotels.description: A relaxed mid-range beach resort on the secluded Kappil Beach. Enjoy the unspoilt shoreline, fresh seafood, and stunning sunset views over the Arabian Sea.

hotels.name: Silent Valley Wilderness Camp
hotels.description: An eco-camp on the fringe of Silent Valley National Park with tent cottages, jungle safaris and bird watching. An unbeatable experience for nature lovers.

hotels.name: Kollam Beach Guest House
hotels.description: A simple, friendly guesthouse steps from Kollam Beach offering clean rooms, warm hospitality and easy access to the Ashtamudi backwaters and boat jetties.

hotels.name: Thrissur Heritage Lodge
hotels.description: A well-kept budget lodge near Thrissur's famous Round (the Vadakkumnathan temple complex). Walking distance to all central attractions including museums and cultural venues.

hotels.name: Nilambur Forest Retreat
hotels.description: A serene forest retreat near the world-famous Nilambur Teak Museum and Conolly's Plot, the oldest teak plantation on earth. Guided teak forest walks and tribal village visits.

hotels.name: Johnson's The Residency Alleppey
hotels.description: A no-frills clean guesthouse in the heart of Alleppey town, just minutes from the boat jetty and beach. Perfect for budget backpackers exploring the backwaters.

hotels.name: Emerald Isle Heritage Villa
hotels.description: A 100-year-old traditional tharavad house on a backwater island accessible only by boat. Experience authentic Kerala village life with home-cooked sadya meals.

hotels.name: Old Harbour Hostel Fort Kochi
hotels.description: A vibrant social hostel in a colonial-era building in Fort Kochi, steps from the Chinese fishing nets and local art galleries. Great for solo and backpacker travellers.

hotels.name: Cochin Seawind Hotel
hotels.description: A comfortable mid-range hotel on the scenic Marine Drive promenade with harbour views, close to shopping malls, restaurants and the ferry to Fort Kochi.

hotels.name: Sunset Homestay Muzhappilangad
hotels.description: A cosy family homestay beside India's longest drive-in beach. Simple rooms, warm Kerala hospitality, fresh fish curry meals, and stunning golden sunsets.

hotels.name: Malabar Ocean Front Resort
hotels.description: A beautifully landscaped beachfront resort near Thottada with spacious cottages, swimming pool and arranged Theyyam folk dance performances for guests.

hotels.name: Chandragiri Fort View Lodge
hotels.description: A clean budget lodge in Kasaragod town near the Chandragiri Fort and river. Ideal base for day trips to Bekal Fort, Valiyaparamba backwaters, and nearby beaches.

hotels.name: Valiyaparamba Backwater Resort
hotels.description: Nestled on a scenic island accessible by country boat, this resort sits on the Valiyaparamba backwaters — one of Kerala's best-kept secrets with four rivers meeting the sea.

hotels.name: Thangassery Lighthouse Guesthouse
hotels.description: A charming budget stay near the historic Thangassery Lighthouse with sea views, run by a local fishing family. Fresh catch cooked daily and sunset views from the terrace.

hotels.name: Munroe Island Eco Resort
hotels.description: Canoe through narrow canals of Munroe Island, an archipelago of 8 small islands. Wooden cottages on stilts, coir-making demonstrations and village walks included.

hotels.name: Plantation Stay Kottayam
hotels.description: A homely guesthouse in a rubber and spice plantation outside Pala town. Peaceful surroundings, home-cooked meals and easy access to Kumarakom and the backwaters.

hotels.name: Kumarakom Lake Resort Classic
hotels.description: A heritage Kerala-style resort on the shores of Vembanad Lake at Kumarakom with rice boat cruises, paddy field walks, bird sanctuary views and Ayurvedic wellness.

hotels.name: Beach Hut Kozhikode
hotels.description: Laid-back budget rooms right on Kozhikode beach, made famous by Vasco da Gama's landing. Enjoy sunset walks, local halwa, and the iconic Calicut pier views.

hotels.name: Westway Hotel Kozhikode
hotels.description: A well-appointed city hotel near the legendary Sweet Meat Street, the heart of Kozhikode's food and shopping scene. Try halwa, banana chips, and authentic Malabar biryani.

hotels.name: Green Valley Inn Malappuram
hotels.description: A clean and affordable lodge in Malappuram town, great base to explore Kadalundi bird sanctuary, Tipu Sultan's fort at Palakkad and the scenic Nilambur forests.

hotels.name: Kadalundi River View Resort
hotels.description: A peaceful riverside resort at the Kadalundi bird sanctuary, one of Kerala's premier migratory bird spots. Best visited from October to March for rare species sightings.

hotels.name: Tea Valley Budget Stay Munnar
hotels.description: Affordable rooms with tea estate views right in Munnar town. Clean, comfortable and conveniently placed for Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam and local markets.

hotels.name: Misty Mountain Resort Munnar
hotels.description: Perched at 5500 ft on the road to Top Station with panoramic views of the Western Ghats. Cloud-level cottages, forest walks and bonfires under a star-filled sky.

hotels.name: Nemmara Homestay Palakkad
hotels.description: A welcoming family homestay on the outskirts of Palakkad near Nemmara. Paddy fields all around, wholesome home cooking and a great base for the Palakkad Gap treks.

hotels.name: Pothundi Dam Resort
hotels.description: A forest-fringed resort beside the scenic Pothundi reservoir surrounded by the Parambikulam Tiger Reserve. Boating, fishing and wildlife spotting from the property.

hotels.name: Lighthouse Beach Hostel Kovalam
hotels.description: A fun backpacker hostel a stone's throw from the iconic Kovalam Lighthouse. Rooftop chill area, social events, yoga classes and unbeatable beach access.

hotels.name: Poovar Island Resort Classic
hotels.description: An island resort at the confluence of the Neyyar river, backwaters, and the Arabian Sea — accessible only by boat. Floating cottages, golden beach and complete seclusion.

hotels.name: Athirappilly Jungle Camp
hotels.description: Basic tented accommodation inside the forest near Athirappilly Falls. Wake up to birdsong and the distant roar of the falls, with guided forest walks included.

hotels.name: Guruvayur Heritage Hotel
hotels.description: A comfortable heritage-style hotel steps from the famous Guruvayur Krishna Temple, one of Kerala's most sacred sites. Vegetarian restaurant serving traditional Kerala temple food.

hotels.name: Sulthan Bathery Backpackers
hotels.description: A friendly hostel in the market town of Sulthan Bathery, gateway to Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary. Budget dorms, travel advice, and the best local Wayanad coffee on tap.

hotels.name: Banasura Hill Resort
hotels.description: An award-winning earth resort built into the Banasura Hills using local materials. Overlooks Asia's largest earthen dam, surrounded by cardamom estates and misty valleys.

hotels.name: Vivanta Thiruvananthapuram
hotels.description: A modern luxury hotel in the heart of the capital with stunning rooftop views of the city and Arabian Sea. Known for impeccable service and authentic Kerala cuisine.

hotels.name: Poovar Island Resort (Secret Escape)
hotels.description: Accessible only by boat, this secret island resort offers floating cottages on the backwaters of Poovar. One of Kerala's most exclusive and hidden luxury retreats.

hotels.name: Bonacaud Bungalow Heritage Stay
hotels.description: A hidden colonial bungalow on a tea estate in the hills. One of the most secret heritage stays in Kerala — virtually unknown to outside tourists. The surrounding jungle and waterfalls are magical.

hotels.name: Green Palms Guesthouse Varkala
hotels.description: A charming budget guesthouse perched on the Varkala cliff with mesmerizing sea views. Popular with backpackers and yogis seeking an authentic cliff-top experience.

hotels.name: CGH Earth Brunton Boatyard
hotels.description: Built on the old British boatyard in Fort Kochi, this heritage luxury hotel blends colonial architecture with modern comforts and commands sweeping views of the historic harbour.

hotels.name: Old Harbour Hotel Fort Kochi
hotels.description: A 300-year-old heritage mansion in Fort Kochi lovingly restored into a boutique luxury hotel. The colonial pillars, antique furniture and tropical garden transport guests to another era.

hotels.name: Cherai Beach Residency
hotels.description: A serene resort on the hidden Cherai Beach where the backwaters meet the sea. Perfect for dolphin watching at sunrise and unwinding away from Kochi's crowds.

hotels.name: Bolghatty Palace Hotel (KTDC)
hotels.description: A 250-year-old Dutch palace converted into a hotel on the isolated Bolghatty Island. Accessible only by ferry, this is one of Kochi's most unique and secret heritage hotel experiences.

hotels.name: Zostel Kochi
hotels.description: A vibrant budget hostel in the heart of Fort Kochi's heritage zone, ideal for backpackers and solo travellers looking to explore colonial streets on a budget.

hotels.name: Kolukkumalai Summit Camp
hotels.description: A secret high-altitude camp at the world's highest tea estate (7900ft). Guests witness the most dramatic sunrise in Kerala above the clouds. Accessible only by jeep through mountain roads.

hotels.name: Tranquil Plantation Hideaway
hotels.description: An ultra-secret plantation hideaway with only 6 cottages nestled in a private coffee estate bordering the shola forest. Perfect for honeymooners and those seeking total seclusion.

hotels.name: Blackberry Hills Retreat
hotels.description: A hidden hillside retreat off the beaten path in Bison Valley with dramatic views of misty tea estates. Known among serious trekkers for access to remote trails rarely shown in guides.

hotels.name: Tea Valley Resort Budget
hotels.description: An affordable base in Munnar town offering clean rooms with tea estate views. Ideal for budget travellers wanting to explore Munnar's scenic trails and waterfalls.

hotels.name: Vythiri Resort
hotels.description: An award-winning jungle resort in the mist-covered forests of Wayanad with stunning treehouse suites, a natural stream, and a zip-line canopy tour. One of Kerala's finest luxury experiences.

hotels.name: Tranquil Resort Wayanad
hotels.description: A secret luxury hideout on a working coffee estate with resident elephants visiting at dawn. Only 6 villas, each with a private pool overlooking the Kabani River valley.

hotels.name: Jungle Hut Wayanad
hotels.description: A rustic eco-resort at the edge of Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary where elephant herds pass through at night. Tribal village tours and forest walks are authentic highlights.

hotels.name: Windy Woods Wayanad
hotels.description: An affordable hillside property in Kalpetta with good connectivity to all Wayanad attractions. Great value for budget travellers exploring the district.

hotels.name: Punnamada Houseboat Elite
hotels.description: Kerala's most luxurious houseboat experience on Punnamada Lake — the venue of the famous Nehru Trophy Boat Race. Private premium kettuvallam with personal chef, sunken jacuzzi and 360° water views.

hotels.name: Pathiramanal Island Eco Lodge
hotels.description: A completely secret eco lodge on the mysterious Pathiramanal Island, accessible only by boat. Home to 50+ rare bird species. Guests often see Siberian cranes at breakfast.

hotels.name: Marari Beach Resort
hotels.description: An award-winning beach resort on the hidden Mararikulam Beach. Built within a coconut grove with traditional Kerala cottages, an Ayurveda village, and direct access to pristine sands.

hotels.name: Budget Backwater Homestay
hotels.description: An authentic below-sea-level homestay in Kuttanad, the rice bowl of Kerala. Wake up to paddy fields, ride a canoe to the market, and enjoy traditional Sadya meals.

hotels.name: Ayurveda Mana Heritage Thrissur
hotels.description: A traditional Tharavadu (ancestral home) converted into a luxury Ayurveda retreat. Treatments use 200-year-old family recipes. One of the most authentic wellness experiences in Kerala.

hotels.name: Vazhachal Forest Retreat
hotels.description: A hidden forest retreat 2km from Athirappilly Falls with private forest access at dawn before tourists arrive. Hornbills, giant squirrels and sometimes elephants are morning visitors.

hotels.name: Hotel Luciya Palace Thrissur
hotels.description: A well-established city hotel in the heart of Thrissur, ideal for visiting Thrissur Pooram and the city's heritage temples. Reliable, comfortable and centrally located.

hotels.name: Bekal Hideaway Resort
hotels.description: A boutique resort on the historically significant Kappad Beach — where Vasco da Gama landed in 1498. Beautifully designed rooms with sea views and a rooftop that overlooks the landing site.

hotels.name: Thusharagiri Waterfall Camp
hotels.description: A secret adventure camp deep inside the Thusharagiri forest, 500m from the main waterfall. Guests have exclusive early morning access to the falls before day visitors arrive.

hotels.name: Malabar Palace Hotel
hotels.description: A reliable and comfortable hotel in the heart of Kozhikode, perfect for experiencing the city's famous Halwa, Biryani culture and exploring Beypore's ancient shipyards.

hotels.name: Zostel Kozhikode
hotels.description: A budget hostel steps away from the famous SM Street (Sweet Meat Street) in Kozhikode. Ideal for solo travellers craving authentic Malabar food and culture on a shoestring.

hotels.name: Malabar Ocean Front Resort
hotels.description: A seafront resort on Asia's longest drive-in beach, offering private beach sections, cultural Theyyam performances and fresh seafood. The ideal base for exploring Kannur's heritage coast.

hotels.name: Anjarakandy Spice Bungalow
hotels.description: A secret colonial estate bungalow on a 200-year-old pepper and cardamom plantation. Guests participate in spice harvesting, colonial cooking and heritage walks. Almost completely unknown outside Kannur.

hotels.name: Costa Malabari Hotel Kannur
hotels.description: A budget beach-adjacent hotel in Kannur offering clean rooms and easy access to Fort St Angelo, Payyambalam Beach and the traditional Theyyam ritual venues.

hotels.name: Bekal Fort Heritage Resort
hotels.description: An extraordinary luxury resort commanding views of Bekal Fort — the largest fort in Kerala. Famous for its iconic infinity pool overlooking the fort and the Arabian Sea. A bucket-list destination.

hotels.name: Ananthapura Lake Temple Guesthouse
hotels.description: A simple guesthouse beside the sacred Ananthapura Lake Temple — Kerala's only lake temple with its famous guardian crocodile. Perfect for pilgrims and heritage travellers.

hotels.name: Ranipuram Hills Camp
hotels.description: A completely secret high-altitude camp at Ranipuram — the 'Ooty of Kasaragod'. Guests are surrounded by shola forest meadows at 760m with zero light pollution. Extraordinary stargazing.

hotels.name: Thenmala Jungle Lodge
hotels.description: India's first planned eco-tourism lodge inside the Thenmala Eco-Tourism Zone. Guests have early morning exclusive access to jungle trails before tourists arrive. Deer graze outside rooms.

hotels.name: Munroe Island Floating Homestay
hotels.description: A secret island homestay on Munroe Island, accessible only by boat. The most authentic backwater experience in Kerala — narrow canals, coir making, old churches and village life completely unchanged.

hotels.name: Sterling Holidays Kollam
hotels.description: A lakeside resort on the pristine Ashtamudi Lake, offering houseboat connections, kayaking and the famous 8-hour boat ride to Alleppey. A less-touristy alternative to Alleppey.

hotels.name: Kakki Reservoir Jungle Camp
hotels.description: A secret riverside camp on Kerala's largest reservoir. Guests enjoy boat rides to Aruvikkal Falls, forest walks in the Periyar Tiger Reserve buffer zone and extraordinary stargazing.

hotels.name: Konni Eco Tourism Centre
hotels.description: Government-run eco lodge at the famous Konni Elephant Training Centre. Budget travellers get authentic elephant care interactions, mahout lessons and river walks in the forest.

hotels.name: Vagamon Mist Valley Resort
hotels.description: A luxury clifftop resort in Vagamon's rolling meadows — one of Kerala's most secret hill stations. The morning mist, paragliding launch pads and pine forest make this an extraordinary escape.

hotels.name: Illikkal Rock Camp
hotels.description: A hidden adventure camp at the base of the legendary Illikkal rock monolith. Climbers and trekkers set out at 5am for sunrise from the 1072m summit. Almost completely unknown.

hotels.name: Philipkutty's Farm
hotels.description: A legendary farm island stay on Vembanad Lake, run by a pioneering Kerala farm family. Guests enjoy canoe rides through the property, bird watching and farm-to-table Kerala cuisine.

hotels.name: Silent Valley Wilderness Camp
hotels.description: One of India's most exclusive wilderness camps at the edge of Silent Valley National Park — India's last virgin tropical rainforest. Limited to 6 guests daily with special permits required.

hotels.name: Parambikulam Eco Huts
hotels.description: Government-run eco huts inside the award-winning Parambikulam Tiger Reserve. One of India's best-value wildlife stays with tiger, elephant and giant squirrel sightings almost guaranteed.

hotels.name: Kairali Ayurvedic Village
hotels.description: An internationally acclaimed Ayurvedic village offering authentic Panchakarma treatments in a serene rural setting. One of South Asia's most respected wellness destinations.

hotels.name: Nilambur Teak Forest Bungalow
hotels.description: A heritage forest bungalow at the edge of the world's oldest teak plantation, established 1844. Guests wake to mist rising over 200-year-old teak trees and Chaliyar River sounds.

hotels.name: Bharatapuzha Riverside Homestay
hotels.description: A peaceful homestay on the ancient banks of Bharatapuzha — Kerala's longest river. The sacred Tirunavaya site of the Mamankam festival is steps away. Deep history, zero crowds.
